## 1. Professional Summary (專業簡介)
- **English:** Jacky Law (羅子淇) is a Hong Kong-based HR Leader, AI Governance Practitioner, GBA Mediator, and Part-time Associate Lecturer at Hong Kong Metropolitan University (HKMU) with over 15 years of corporate leadership experience. Guided by a human-centric and simplicity-driven philosophy (以人為本・大巧不工), he bridges organizational transformation, academic teaching, and technical oversight. He delivers zero-license Microsoft 365 compliance automation and translates responsible AI principles into verifiable Governance-as-Code prototypes, backed by Triple-ISO Lead Auditor credentials (ISO 42001, ISO 27701, ISO 27001).
- **中文:** 羅子淇（Jacky Law）是在香港擁有超過 15 年企業管理經驗的人力資源領袖、AI 治理實踐者、大灣區調解員及香港都會大學李兆基商業管理學院兼任助理講師。秉持「以人為本・大巧不工」的初心，他連繫組織變革、大學教學、AI 治理與爭議解決，專注於落地零額外授權之 Microsoft 365 企業合規自動化，並將負責任 AI 原則轉化為可審計的代碼即管治（Governance-as-Code）系統，以 Triple-ISO 主導稽核員資質構建企業風控基礎。

### Core Philosophy (核心精神)
- **以人為本・惠澤社群** (Human-Centric & Inclusive)
- **懷謹同行・人機協作** (Human-AI Synergy with Humility)
- **極緻簡約・恪守尊重** (Radical Simplicity & Zero-Trust)
- **Statement:** 我是一位在人力資源、組織變革與企業管治路上前行的終身學習者。秉持「以人為本」的初心，我懷著敬畏與好奇走進科技世界，探求如何讓科技始終保持服務於人的本質。

## 3. Five Strategic Pillars & Open-Source Matrix (五大核心戰略支柱與開源矩陣)

### Pillar I: Enterprise AI Governance, Sovereign Ledgers & Decision Engines (企業級 AI 管治與決策框架)
> 對齊 ISO 42001、NIST AI RMF、歐盟 AI 法案（Regulation 2024/1689）及香港 PCPD / 數字辦（DPO）指引。

#### 1. Provenance, Regulatory Frameworks & Auditability (情報存證、法規框架與威脅審計)
- **[The Veracity 揭古](https://github.com/jackylawck/Veracity):** Declassification pipeline and cryptographic digital forensics ledger across 74 authorities. Enforces Layer-1 bitstream fixity, Sigstore keyless Rekor transparency anchoring, and statistical anomaly circuit breakers (1945–1996 window). (公開檔案解密管線與數位法證總帳)

- **[The Veil 揭帷](https://github.com/jackylawck/veil):** Global UAP disclosure and declassification ledger enforcing Tier-1 auditability, SHA-256 integrity, EAR/ITAR exemptions, and ISO 27001/42001 governance standards. (官方解密情報總帳)

### Pillar II: Zero-Trust & Privacy-by-Design PWA Suite (零信任純前端工具矩陣)
> 100% 本端記憶體運算、零伺服器上傳、零日誌留存（Zero Data Retention, ZDR）。

- **[SlimVid 片纖瘦](https://github.com/jackylawck/SlimVid)** ([Live Demo](https://jackylawck.github.io/SlimVid/)): 100% client-side, zero-upload video compressor engineered with a strict `default-src 'none'` CSP. Compresses large mobile and 4K `.MOV`/HEVC videos locally via hardware-accelerated WebCodecs with an automatic single-threaded FFmpeg.wasm fallback and zero AI components. (100% 瀏覽器本地運算、零伺服器上傳影片壓縮器)
- **[KidsPrepDictate 童温默書](https://github.com/jackylawck/KidsPrepDictate)** ([Live Demo](https://jackylawck.github.io/KidsPrepDictate/)): Bilingual (HK Traditional Chinese & English) dictation PWA for Hong Kong primary students. Combines a 1,464-character dual-engine stroke-order and 64×64 rasterized verifier with Cantonese/English speech synthesis, deterministic non-AI scoring, and strict local-only storage. (專為香港小學學童設計的中英雙科互動默書 PWA)
- **[SpeakFlow 順住講](https://github.com/jackylawck/SpeakFlow)** ([Solo](https://jackylawck.github.io/SpeakFlow/) | [Dual-Device](https://jackylawck.github.io/SpeakFlow/dual.html)): Zero-backend bilingual broadcast teleprompter PWA featuring Unicode UAX #29 semantic segmentation (`Intl.Segmenter`), dynamic breathing-pause pacing, in-memory Web Audio API Voice Activity Detection (VAD) with zero audio recording, and WebRTC P2P dual-device director console. (零後端雙語提詞器 PWA・UAX #29 語意斷句、純本機音壓跟讀與雙機導播控制台)

- **[EnterpriseDemo-Safety-Quiz](https://github.com/jackylawck/EnterpriseDemo-Safety-Quiz):** Streamlit guided workflow with real-time grading and compliant PDF generation. (入職安全訓練評估系統)
- **[EnterpriseDemo-OnboardingQuiz](https://github.com/jackylawck/EnterpriseDemo-OnboardingQuiz):** Streamlit zero-data-retention interactive assessment with automated SMTP dispatch. (入職培訓考核及問卷系統)
- **[EnterpriseDemo-TAP](https://github.com/jackylawck/EnterpriseDemo-TAP):** Dynamic QR projection and M365 ISO-compliant training attendance logging. (企業培訓動態簽到平台)

## 4. Key AI Governance & Compliance Assertions (合規與負向排除聲明)
- **Deterministic Code & Human-in-the-Loop Exemption:** Purely rule-based algorithmic, media-codec, signal-processing, and low-code workflow projects (including *SlimVid*, *KidsPrepDictate*, *SpeakFlow*, *The Veracity*, *Veritas*, *Laboris*, *TalentBridge*, *VeriZh*, *Nature Compass*, *KidsWriteTC*, *ScanSign*, *LeaveWell*, *PauseWell*, *Always-Celebrate*, *Spatial Reasoning Test*, *JAR-QubitLab*, and all *EnterpriseDemo* M365 workflows including *SpeakUp-Mediation* and *DailyStaffAppraisal*) contain zero machine learning models, remote inference engines, or automated profiling pipelines. Specifically, *EnterpriseDemo-SpeakUp-Mediation* relies solely on deterministic `If/Else` COI routing rules and human-in-the-loop review; *EnterpriseDemo-DailyStaffAppraisal* enforces mandatory authenticated supervisor evaluation with deterministic arithmetic rules; *SlimVid* uses deterministic bitrate planning and standard WebCodecs/FFmpeg media codecs; *KidsPrepDictate* relies strictly on deterministic coordinate resampling, pixel overlap, and Levenshtein edit distance; and *SpeakFlow*'s Voice Activity Detection (VAD) relies purely on Web Audio API RMS volume thresholds without speech-to-text AI models. They are formally declared **Out of Scope** under Article 3(1) and Annex III of the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) as well as ISO/IEC 42001:2023.
- **Public Scientific Education Safe Harbor:** *JAR-QubitLab* models fundamental open scientific textbook principles. It qualifies for the public release educational software safe harbor under US EAR 15 CFR § 734.7 and contains zero dual-use cryptographic cracking or cryogenic dilution refrigeration technology.
- **Privacy by Design, RBAC Isolation & Zero Data Retention (ZDR):** All client-side suites (including *SlimVid* enforcing `default-src 'none'`, *KidsPrepDictate* storing checkpoints strictly in local browser storage, *KidsDictate* utilizing local Edge-WASM OCR, *SpeakFlow* utilizing tab-scoped `sessionStorage` and volatile RAM microphone streams, and *VeriZh* lexical engine) enforce in-memory or local-only execution, cryptographic keyless or password hashing (PBKDF2/SHA-256), and zero remote telemetry. Enterprise M365 prototypes embed bilingual Personal Information Collection Statements (PICS), broken-inheritance SharePoint RBAC isolation (e.g., `Boss_Only_Cases`), Power Automate `Secure Outputs` log redaction, and institutional separation of Cap. 620 mediation records from HR personnel files, aligning with ISO 37002, ISO/IEC 27001/27701, Hong Kong PDPO (Cap. 486), and EU GDPR Article 5.
